name: Trăng và sao băng
notes: A couple on a grassy hilltop at twilight (the shared grown-up couple in templates/_models: Grab3D's Casual Man and Casual Woman with Quaternius's animations, CC0, in their own clothes; she is fitted at .945 of his height). The hill, its swaying grass and wildflowers, a lone tree, a stone lantern, the magic-hour sky with far hills and a town, the moon and the comet are built in story.js. Stop 1: the sky unfolds and the hill swells out of the card; she leads him up the hill by the hand while a huge moon rises behind the far hills, points at it, and they lie down side by side to watch as the stars come out; a note with the card's first words (slot note1) comes up. Stop 2: a great comet glides down the sky, they sit up to watch, and its tail parts into a cyan strand and a pink one that curl round into a heart; the card's photo lights up inside it with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: the heart drifts aside and a meteor shower falls, some meteors bursting into tiny hearts; they scoot close, hold hands and make a wish; a last bright meteor flashes and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
